tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of major previous IT / ITES outsourcing contracts executed during the last five years and details of providing such manpower to the Central Government or State Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India.

Minimum 5 years of experience in providing IT / ITES outsourcing contracts executed during the last ten years and details of providing such manpower to the Central Government or State Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India

Size of the Firm (No. of IT Professionals and details of the professionals shall be submitted along with proof of current working status). The bidder shall have a minimum of 200 technically qualified employees on its payroll as on the last date of submission of the bid. Documentary proof such as a certificate from the authorised signatory of the company, supported by the latest EPF/ECR return or equivalent statutory records, shall be submitted along with the bid. Technically qualified employees" means personnel means engaged in IT/ITES, software development, data centre / infrastructure management,networking, database administration, GIS, cybersecurity, DevOps, application support or allied technical services, and excludes purely administrative, HR, finance, housekeeping and nontechnical personnel.

The Bidder should have experience in Data Centre Management, IT Infrastructure Management, Software Application Development / Maintenance, GIS Application Development / Maintenance, Database Administration, Network Administration, DevOps or IT / ITES Managed Services in / within Central Government or State Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India
Satisfactory performance certificates from previous or current major clients for the last five consecutive years
Financial Strength Based on Average annual turnover
